29 September 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, September 29, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 22 September 2026.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 29 September 2026.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

Public Disclosure of Personal Information

  • Members of the public should be aware that questions submitted to the City of Greater Geraldton form part of the public decision-making process.
  • Your name and address are required by law and may be provided to Council, included in agenda and minute documents, retained in the City's corporate records and published on the City's website.
  • Public question time is live-streamed and recorded on the City’s website. By filling out this form and/or partaking in public question time, you acknowledge that your image and the information you provide may become a public record and may be publicly accessible by any person. 

Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – DATE 2026”

25 August 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, August 25, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 1.30pm on Tuesday 18 August 2026 at Mullewa District Office, Cnr Thomas St and Padbury St, Mullewa

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 25 August 2026.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting. 

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum is not livestreamed due to its location in Mullewa.  The Ordinary Meeting of Council is livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

Public Disclosure of Personal Information

  • Members of the public should be aware that questions submitted to the City of Greater Geraldton form part of the public decision-making process.
  • Your name and address are required by law and may be provided to Council, included in agenda and minute documents, retained in the City's corporate records and published on the City's website.
  • Public question time is live-streamed and recorded on the City’s website. By filling out this form and/or partaking in public question time, you acknowledge that your image and the information you provide may become a public record and may be publicly accessible by any person. 

Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 August 2026”

28 July 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, July 28, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 5.30pm on Tuesday 21 July 2026 at Walkaway Public Hall, Padbury Road, Walkaway.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 28 July 2026.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum is not livestreamed due to its location.  The Ordinary Meeting of Council is livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum and the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

Public Disclosure of Personal Information

  • Members of the public should be aware that questions submitted to the City of Greater Geraldton form part of the public decision-making process.
  • Your name and address are required by law and may be provided to Council, included in agenda and minute documents, retained in the City's corporate records and published on the City's website.
  • Public question time is live-streamed and recorded on the City’s website. By filling out this form and/or partaking in public question time, you acknowledge that your image and the information you provide may become a public record and may be publicly accessible by any person. 

Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 July 2026”

30 June 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, June 30, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 23 June 2026.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 30 June 2026.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 30 June 2026”

26 May 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, May 26, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 19 May 2026.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 26 May 2026.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 26 May 2026”

28 April 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, April 28, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 21 April 2026.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 28 April 2026.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 April 2026”

31 March 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, March 31, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 1.30pm on Tuesday 24 March 2026 at Mullewa District Office, Cnr Thomas St and Padbury St, Mullewa. 

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 31 March 2026.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum is not livestreamed due to its location in Mullewa.  The Ordinary Meeting of Council is livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 31 March 2026”

24 February 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, February 24, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 17 February 2026.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 24 February 2026.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 24 February 2026”

27 January 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, January 27, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 20 January 2026.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm/at the Conclusion of the Annual Meeting of Electors, on Tuesday 27 January 2026.

NOTE: Prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council - the Annual Meeting of Electors will be held at 5pm.

Public Notice - Public Notice Annual Meeting of Electors (27 January 2026) and availability of the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2024-25 » City of Greater Geraldton

Please visit: 27 January 2026 - Annual Meeting of Electors » City of Greater Geraldton for the meeting papers.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 27 January 2026”

27 January 2026 - Annual Meeting of Electors

Tuesday, January 27, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

Annual Meeting of Electors (27 January 2026) and availability of the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2024-25

Public Notice - Public Notice Annual Meeting of Electors (27 January 2026) and availability of the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2024-25 » City of Greater Geraldton

In accordance with s.5.29 of the Local Government Act 1995, the City of Greater Geraldton gives notice of the Annual Meeting of Electors:

  • The meeting will be held on Tuesday 27 January 2026 at 5pm in Chambers at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.
  • The purpose of the meeting is to discuss the contents of the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2024-25, and any other general business.

Electors may submit questions in writing to the Chief Executive Officer relating to the meeting, no later than 5.00pm on Friday 23 January 2026 in order that adequate responses may be prepared and given at the meeting.  The question time guide can be found on our website via this link: Questions From the Public » City of Greater Geraldton

The Agenda will be available on the City of Greater Geraldton’s website before close of business Friday 23 January 2026.

Notice is also given, as required under s.5.55 of the Local Government Act 1995, that the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2024-25 is available on the City’s website at www.cgg.wa.gov.au/annual-reports and for inspection at the City’s Cathedral Avenue office and Mullewa District office during normal office hours.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Annual Meeting of Electors – 27 January 2026”

21 October 2025 - Special Meeting of Council

Tuesday, October 21, 2025 - 04:00 PM

Members of the Public are advised that a Special Meeting of Council will be held in the City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton on Tuesday 21 October 2025 at 4.00pm.

This meeting is convened to swear in the newly elected Councillors and for the Council to elect the Deputy Mayor for a two-year term ending October 2027, in accordance with the Local Government Act 1995.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The agenda will be available at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue and on the website the Friday prior to this meeting.

The Special Meeting of Council and Agenda Forum, that is also being held on this date, are livestreamed.  The Agenda Forum will commence at 5pm.

27 May 2025 - Annual Meeting of Electors

Tuesday, May 27, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Annual Meeting of Electors (27 May 2025) and availability of the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2023-2024

In accordance with s.5.29 of the Local Government Act 1995, the City of Greater Geraldton hereby gives public notice of the Annual Meeting of Electors. 

The meeting will be held on Tuesday 27 May 2025 at 5pm in Chambers at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.  The purpose of the meeting is to consider the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2023-24, and any other general business.

Notice is also given, as required under s.5.55 of the Local Government Act 1995, that the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2023-24 is available for inspection at the City’s Cathedral Avenue office and Mullewa District office during normal office hours, and on the City’s website at Annual Reports » City of Greater Geraldton

16 December 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, December 16, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 9 December 2025.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 16 December 2025.

Meeting agendas will be available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 16 December 2025”

25 November 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, November 25, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 November 2025.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 November 2025.

Meeting agendas will be available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 November 2025”

28 October 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, October 28, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 October 2025.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 28 October 2025.

Meeting agendas will be available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 October 2025”

21 October 2025 - Special Meeting of Council

Tuesday, October 21, 2025 - 04:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

Members of the Public are advised that a Special Meeting of Council will be held in the City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton on Tuesday 21 October 2025 at 4.00pm.

This meeting is convened to swear in the newly elected Councillors and for the Council to elect the Deputy Mayor for a two-year term ending October 2027, in accordance with the Local Government Act 1995.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The agenda will be available at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue and on the website the Friday prior to this meeting.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council, you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Special Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Special Meeting of Council questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Special Meeting of Council to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton 

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Special Meeting of Council – 21 October 2025”

30 September 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, September 30, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum was held at 5.00pm Tuesday 23 September 2025.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting was held at 5.00pm Tuesday 30 September 2025.

Meeting agendas are made available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 30 September 2025”

26 August 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, August 26, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: See meeting page for locations

The Agenda Forum was held at 1.30pm Tuesday 19 August 2025. [Livestream is not available] at Mullewa District Office, Cnr of Thomas & Padbury Street, Mullewa

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting was held at 5.00pm Tuesday 26 August 2025 at Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Meeting agendas are made available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Only the Ordinary Meeting of Council is livestreamed.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 26 August 2025”

29 July 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, July 29, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: See meeting page for locations

The Agenda Forum will be held at 5.30pm Tuesday 22 July 2025. [Livestream is not available] at Walkaway Public Hall, Padbury Road, Walkaway.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 29 July 2025 at Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Meeting agendas will be available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Only the Ordinary Meeting of Council is livestreamed.

******************************************************************************

[1] Questions to Agenda Forum - 22 July 2025

Members of public attending the meeting in Walkway will be able to submit up to three questions to the Agenda Forum.  Send them to council@cgg.wa.gov.au titled “Questions to Agenda Forum – 22 July 2025”.  Please submit questions before 12 noon on Monday 21 July 2025. Please refer to the link below for the procedure of Public Question Time which will apply to this meeting.

******************************************************************************

[2] Questions to Council - 29 July 2025

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 29 July 2025”

24 June 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, June 24, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 17 June 2025.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 24 June 2025.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 24 June 2025”

27 May 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, May 27, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 20 May 2025.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at conclusion of the Annual Meeting of Electors on Tuesday 27 May 2025.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 27 May 2025”

27 May 2025 - Annual Meeting of Electors

Tuesday, May 27, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Annual Meeting of Electors (27 May 2025) and availability of the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2023-2024

In accordance with s.5.29 of the Local Government Act 1995, the City of Greater Geraldton hereby gives public notice of the Annual Meeting of Electors. 

The meeting will be held on Tuesday 27 May 2025 at 5pm in Chambers at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.  The purpose of the meeting is to consider the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2023-24, and any other general business.

Notice is also given, as required under s.5.55 of the Local Government Act 1995, that the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2023-24 is available for inspection at the City’s Cathedral Avenue office and Mullewa District office during normal office hours, and on the City’s website at Annual Reports » City of Greater Geraldton

Questions to Annual Meeting of Electors

Electors may submit questions in writing to the Chief Executive Officer relating to the meeting, no later than 5.00pm on Friday 23 May 2025 in order that adequate responses may be prepared and given at the meeting.   The question time guide can be found on our website via the below link.

The Agenda will be available on the City of Greater Geraldton’s website by Friday 23 May 2025

Attachment:

The City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2023-24 is located here: Annual Reports » City of Greater Geraldton

Note: The Ordinary Meeting of Council of 27 May 2025 will commence at the conclusion of this meeting.

29 April 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, April 29, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 22 April 2025.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 29 April 2025.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 29 April 2025”

25 March 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, March 25, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: See meeting page for locations

The Agenda Forum will be held at 1.30pm Tuesday 18 March 2025 [Livestream is not available] at Mullewa District Office, Cnr of Thomas & Padbury Street, Mullewa

Questions to Council – at this Agenda Forum.

Members of public attending the meeting in Mullewa will be able to submit questions to the Agenda Forum.

Send them to council@cgg.wa.gov.au “Questions to Agenda Forum – 18 March 2025”,

Please submit questions before 12 noon on Monday 17 March 2025. 

***********

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 March 2025 at Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Only the Ordinary Meeting of Council is livestreamed

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 March 2025”

25 February 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, February 25, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 February 2025.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 February 2025.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 February 2025”

28 January 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, January 28, 2025 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 January 2025.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 28 January 2025.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: 

  • Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.
  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 January 2025”

27 February 2024 - Annual Meeting of Electors

Tuesday, February 27, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Annual Meeting of Electors (27 February 2024) and availability of the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2022-23

In accordance with s.5.29 of the Local Government Act 1995, the City of Greater Geraldton hereby gives public notice of the Annual Meeting of Electors. 

The meeting will be held on Tuesday 27 February 2024 at 5pm in Chambers at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.  The purpose of the meeting is to consider the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2022-23, and any other general business.

Notice is also given, as required under s.5.55 of the Local Government Act 1995, that the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2022-23 is available for inspection at the City’s Cathedral Avenue office and Mullewa District office during normal office hours, and on the City’s website at www.cgg.wa.gov.au/annual-reports

17 December 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, December 17, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 10 December 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 17 December 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 17 December 2024”

26 November 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, November 26, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm *MONDAY* 18 November 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Note: The Annual HMAS II Sydney Memorial Service is on Tuesday 19 November 2024. 

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 26 November 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 26 November 2024”

29 October 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, October 29, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 22 October 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 29 October 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 29 October 2024”

24 September 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, September 24, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 17 September 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 24 September 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 24 September 2024”

27 August 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, August 27, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 1.30pm Tuesday 20 August 2024, at Mullewa District Office, Corner of Thomas and Padbury Streets, Mullewa.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 27 August 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 27 August 2024”

Tuesday, July 30, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Members of public attending the meeting in Walkway will be able to submit up to three questions to the Agenda Forum.  Send them to council@cgg.wa.gov.au titled “Questions to Agenda Forum – 23 July 2024”.  Please submit questions before 12 noon on Monday 22 July 2024.

Please refer to the link below for the procedure of Public Question Time which will apply to this meeting.

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 30 July 2024”

25 June 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, June 25, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 June 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 June 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 June 2024”

28 May 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, May 28, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 May 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 28 May 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 May 2024”

30 April 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, April 30, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 23 April 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 30 April 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 30 April 2024”

26 March 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, March 26, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 1.30pm Tuesday 19 March 2024, at Mullewa District Office, Corner of Thomas and Padbury Streets, Mullewa.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 26 March 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 26 March 2024”
