27 February 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, February 27, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 20 February 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

NOTE: The Council Meeting will be held at the conclusion of the Annual Meeting of Electors on Tuesday 27 February 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 27 February 2024”

27 February 2024 - Annual Meeting of Electors

Tuesday, February 27, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Annual Meeting of Electors (27 February 2024) and availability of the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2022-23

In accordance with s.5.29 of the Local Government Act 1995, the City of Greater Geraldton hereby gives public notice of the Annual Meeting of Electors. 

The meeting will be held on Tuesday 27 February 2024 at 5pm in Chambers at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.  The purpose of the meeting is to consider the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2022-23, and any other general business.

Notice is also given, as required under s.5.55 of the Local Government Act 1995, that the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2022-23 is available for inspection at the City’s Cathedral Avenue office and Mullewa District office during normal office hours, and on the City’s website at www.cgg.wa.gov.au/annual-reports 

Questions to Annual Meeting of Electors

Electors may submit questions in writing to the Chief Executive Officer relating to the meeting, no later than 5.00pm on Friday 23 February 2024 in order that adequate responses may be prepared and given at the meeting.   The question time guide can be found on our website via the below link.

The Agenda will be available on the City of Greater Geraldton’s website on Friday 23 February 2024: https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/council-meetings/

Attachments

Attachment 1 - Minutes of the Annual Meeting of Electors held on 31 January 2023 are located here. 

Attachment 2 - The City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2022-23 is located here: Annual Reports » City of Greater Geraldton (cgg.wa.gov.au) 

Note: The Ordinary Meeting of Council of 27 February 2024 will commence at the conclusion of this meeting.

30 January 2024 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, January 30, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 23 January 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 30 January 2024, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. A member of the public is entitled to ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending question(s) via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 30 January 2024”

19 December 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, December 19, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 12 December 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 19 December 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 19 December 2023”

28 November 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, November 28, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 November 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 28 November 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

31 October 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, October 31, 2023 - 05:00 PM

Location: Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 24 October 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 31 October 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 31 October 2023”

24 October 2023 - Special Meeting of Council to swear in newly elected Mayor / Councillors and to elect the Deputy Mayor

Tuesday, October 24, 2023 - 04:00 PM - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

Members of the Public are advised that a Special Meeting of Council will be held in the City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton on Tuesday 24 October 2023 at 4.00pm.

The purpose of this meeting is to swear in the newly elected Mayor and Councillors (under the Local Government Act 1995) and for the Council to elect the Deputy Mayor for a two-year term ending October 2025.

The agenda will be available at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue and on the website closer to the date.

Ross McKim

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

26 September 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, September 26, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 19 September 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 26 September 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 26 September 2023”

29 August 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, August 29, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 1.30pm Tuesday 22 August 2023, at **Mullewa District Office**

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 29 August 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 29 August 2023”

25 July 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, July 25, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 July 2023, at **Walkaway Recreation Centre, Evans Road, Walkaway**

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 July 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

****************************************************************

[1] Questions to Agenda Forum - 18 July 2023

Members of public attending the meeting in Walkway will be able to submit up to three questions to the Agenda Forum.  Send them to council@cgg.wa.gov.au titled “Questions to Agenda Forum – 18 July 2023”.  Please submit questions before 12 noon on Monday 17 July 2023. Please refer to the link below for the procedure of Public Question Time which will apply to this meeting.

****************************************************************

[2] Questions to Council - 25 July 2023

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 July 2023”

27 June 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, June 27, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 20 June 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 27 June 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 27 June 2023”

30 May 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, May 30, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 23 May 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 30 May 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 30 May 2023”

26 April 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Wednesday, April 26, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 April 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm WEDNESDAY 26 April 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 26 April 2023”

28 February 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, February 28, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 February 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 28 February 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 February 2023”

Annual Meeting of Electors - 31 January 2023

Tuesday, January 31, 2023 - 05:00 PM

Public Notice

In accordance with s.5.29 of the Local Government Act 1995, the City of Greater Geraldton hereby gives public notice of the Annual Meeting of Electors. 

The meeting will be held on Tuesday 31 January 2023 at 5pm in Chambers at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.  

The purpose of the meeting is to consider the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2021-22 and any other general business.

Notice is also given, as required under s.5.55 of the Local Government Act 1995, that the City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2021-22 is available for inspection at the City’s Cathedral Avenue office and Mullewa District office during normal office hours and on the City’s website.

Questions to Annual Meeting of Electors

Electors may submit questions in writing to the Chief Executive Officer relating to the meeting, no later than 5.00pm on Friday 27 January 2023 in order that adequate responses may be prepared and given at the meeting.   The question time guide can be found on our website via this link Questions From the Public 

Agenda/Attachments

The Agenda was published on Friday 27 January 2023.

Attachment 1 - Minutes of the Annual Meeting of Electors held on 25 January 2022 are located here. 

Attachment 2 - The City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2021-22 is located here: Annual Reports » City of Greater Geraldton (cgg.wa.gov.au) 

Note: The Ordinary Meeting of Council of 31 January 2023 will commence at the conclusion of this meeting. 

Ross McKim

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

31 January 2023 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, January 31, 2023 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 24 January 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will commence at the conclusion of the Annual Meeting of Electors, Tuesday 31 January 2023, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 31 January 2023”

20 December 2022

Tuesday, December 20, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 13 December 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 20 December 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 20 December 2022”

29 November 2022

Tuesday, November 29, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 22 November 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 29 November 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 29 November 2022”

Tuesday, October 25, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 October 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 October 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 October 2022”

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 30 August 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 30 August 2022”

26 July 2022

Tuesday, July 26, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 19 July 2022, at the **Walkaway Recreational Centre, Evans Road, Walkaway**

NOTE: There is no livestreaming available for the Agenda Forum, due to its location in Walkaway.

******************************************************************************************************************************************************

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 26 July 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 26 July 2022”

28 June 2022

Tuesday, June 28, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 June 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 28 June 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 June 2022”

31 May 2022

Tuesday, May 31, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 24 May 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 31 May 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 31 May 2022”

26 April 2022

Tuesday, April 26, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 19 April 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 26 April 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend Agenda Forums and Council Meetings.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 26 April 2022”

29 March 2022

Tuesday, March 29, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 22 March 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 29 March 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 29 March 2022”

22 February 2022

Tuesday, February 22, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 15 February 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 22 February 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 22 February 2022”

25 January 2022

Tuesday, January 25, 2022 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 January 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 January 2022, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 January 2022”

Annual Meeting of Electors - 25 January 2022

Tuesday, January 25, 2022 - 05:00 PM

Notice is hereby given that the Annual Meeting of Electors for the City of Greater Geraldton will be held on Tuesday 25 January 2022 at 5pm in Chambers at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue.

Electors may submit questions in writing to the Chief Executive Officer relating to the meeting, no later than 5.00pm on Thursday 20 January 2022 in order that adequate responses may be prepared and given at the meeting.  Details on public question protocols can be found here.   

The Agenda will be available on the City of Greater Geraldton’s website on Friday 21 January 2022.

Attachment 1 - Minutes of the Annual Meeting of Electors held on 23 March 2021 are located here. 

Attachment 2 - The City of Greater Geraldton Annual Report 2020-21 is available for inspection at the City’s Cathedral Avenue office, and Mullewa District office during normal office hours and available at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/annual-reports.aspx

Note: The Ordinary Meeting of Council of 25 January 2022 will commence at the conclusion of this meeting. 

Ross McKim

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Annual Meeting of Electors - 23 March 2021

Tuesday, March 23, 2021 - 05:00 PM

Notice is hereby given that the Annual Electors Meeting for the City of Greater Geraldton will be held on Tuesday 23 March 2021 at 5pm in Chambers at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue.

Electors may submit questions in writing to the Chief Executive Officer relating to the meeting, no later than 5.00pm on Thursday 18 March 2021 in order that adequate responses may be prepared and given at the meeting.  

To assist you on the protocols of Public Question Time, please visit the City’s Website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx

Attachment 1 - Minutes of the Annual Meeting of Electors held on 28 January 2020, are located here 

Attachment 2 - The  Annual Report 2019-20 and General Purpose Financial Statements are available here, and will also be available for inspection at the City of Greater Geraldton Cathedral Avenue office and Mullewa District office during normal office hours. 

The Ordinary Meeting of Council will commence at the conclusion of this meeting. Council Meeting Details » City of Greater Geraldton (cgg.wa.gov.au) 

Ross McKim

21 December 2021

Tuesday, December 21, 2021 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 14 December 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 December 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 21 December 2021”

23 November 2021

Tuesday, November 23, 2021 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 16 November 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 23 November 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 23 November 2021”

26 October 2021

Tuesday, October 26, 2021 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 19 October 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 26 October 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 26 October 2021”

18 October 2021 - SPECIAL Meeting of Council - Swear in newly elected Councillors and Election of Deputy Mayor

Monday, October 18, 2021 - 05:00 PM

Members of the Public are advised that a Special Meeting of Council will be held in the City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, Cathedral Avenue on Monday 18 October 2021 at 5.00pm.

The purpose of this meeting is to swear in newly elected Councillors (under the Local Government Act 1995) and for the Council to elect the Deputy Mayor for the next term of Council.

The agenda will be available at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue and on the website closer to the date.

We would like to pay our respect to the Elders past, present and future for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of the Yamatji Peoples.

28 September 2021

Tuesday, September 28, 2021 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 September 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 28 September 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 September 2021”

24 August 2021

Tuesday, August 24, 2021 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 1.30pm Tuesday 17 August 2021, at Mullewa District Office

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 24 August 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 24 August 2021”

Tuesday, July 27, 2021 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 20 July 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 27 July 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 22 June 2021”

25 May 2021

Tuesday, May 25, 2021 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 May 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 May 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 May 2021”

27 April 2021

Tuesday, April 27, 2021 - 05:00 PM

*Agenda Forum Cancelled*
The April Council Agenda Forum Meeting, scheduled for 20 April, has been cancelled. Due to the aftermath of Tropical Cyclone Seroja, the decision was made to cancel the Agenda Forum. The April Council Agenda will now be solely considered at the Ordinary Council Meeting scheduled for Tuesday 27 April 2021 at 5pm in Council Chambers. 

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 27 April 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 27 April 2021”

23 March 2021

Tuesday, March 23, 2021 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 1.30pm Tuesday 16 March 2021, at Mullewa District Office

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 23 March 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 23 March 2021”

Annual Meeting of Electors - 28 January 2020

Tuesday, January 28, 2020 - 05:00 PM

Notice is hereby given that the Annual Electors Meeting for the City of Greater Geraldton will be held on Tuesday 28 January 2020 at 5pm in Chambers at the City’s offices, Cathedral Avenue.

Electors may submit questions in writing to the Chief Executive Officer relating to the meeting, no later than 5.00pm on Thursday 23 January 2020 in order that adequate responses may be prepared and given at the meeting.  

The  Annual Report 2018-19 and General Purpose Financial Statements are available here, and will also be available for inspection at the City of Greater Geraldton Cathedral Avenue office and Mullewa District office during normal office hours. 

Minutes of the Annual Meeting of Electors held on 18 December 2018, are located here 

The Ordinary Meeting of Council will commence at the conclusion of this meeting. https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/council-meetings/ordinary-council-meeting/28-january-2020/154

Ross McKim

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

23 February 2021

Tuesday, February 23, 2021 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 16 February 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 23 February 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 23 February 2021”

27 January 2021 - Wednesday

Wednesday, January 27, 2021 - 05:00 PM

*Agenda Forum Cancelled* 
The January Council Agenda Forum Meeting, scheduled for 19 January, has been cancelled. Due to the small size and content of the draft agenda it has been decided that to hold the Agenda Forum would not be an effective use of resources. The January Council Agenda will now be solely considered at the Ordinary Council Meeting scheduled for Wednesday 27 January 2021 at 5pm in Council Chambers. 

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm WEDNESDAY 27 January 2021, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question(s) to :

Chief Executive Officer

City of Greater Geraldton

PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 27 January 2021”

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 July 2020”

Please note the following:

In accordance with the Local Government Act 1995 section 5.25(1)(ba) and the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, regulation 14D, a council  meeting may be held by electronic means if a public health emergency or a  state of emergency exists in the whole of the district of a local government.

Refer to Public Notice here

A State of Emergency and a Public Health Emergency were declared in Western Australia on 16 March 2020, and remain in force.

Livestreaming

Live streaming will not be available for eMeetings. Unconfirmed Minutes will be available on the City website within 10 business days as required under the provisions of the Local Government Act 1995 section 5.23(1) and the Local Government (Administration)Regulations 1996 regulation 13 and 14E.

Public Questions 

The City of Greater Geraldton encourages community interest in Local Government. Public Question Time will continue at the eMeetings in a modified format.

As no public or physical attendance at council meetings will be allowed during the State of Emergency public involvement in the eMeeting shall be limited to written questions only.

Questions may be provided to the City no later than 12pm on the day prior to the meeting and will be responded to at the meeting. Forms which specify these conditions are available at http://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx Further information can be obtained by contacting Sheri Moulds on (08) 9956 6600 or council@cgg.wa.gov.au.

25 February 2020

Tuesday, February 25, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 February 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 February 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 February 2020”

15 December 2020

Tuesday, December 15, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 8 December 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 15 December 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 15 December 2020”
