24 November 2020

Tuesday, November 24, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 17 November 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 24 November 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 24 November 2020”

27 October 2020

Tuesday, October 27, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 20 October 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 27 October 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 27 October 2020”

22 September 2020

Tuesday, September 22, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 15 September 2020, in Chambers, Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 22 September 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 22 September 2020”

Tuesday, August 25, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 1.30pm Tuesday 18 August 2020, in MULLEWA District Office.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

23 June 2020

Tuesday, June 23, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The State of Emergency and Public Health Emergency declared by the State Government on 16 March 2020, remains in force.  Agenda Forums and Ordinary Meetings of Council will be held at the Civic Centre, with current physical distancing measures to be adhered to as per Phase 3 of the WA Roadmap dated 6 June 2020.

https://www.wa.gov.au/organisation/department-of-the-premier-and-cabinet/covid-19-coronavirus-wa-roadmap#phase3  

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 16 June 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 23 June 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 23 June 2020”

26 May 2020

Tuesday, May 26, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 19 May 2020, via eMeeting

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 26 May 2020, via eMeeting.

Please note the following:

In accordance with the Local Government Act 1995 section 5.25(1)(ba) and the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, regulation 14D, a council  meeting may be held by electronic means if a public health emergency or a  state of emergency exists in the whole of the district of a local government.

Refer to Public Notice here

A State of Emergency and a Public Health Emergency were declared in Western Australia on 16 March 2020, and remain in force.

Livestreaming

Live streaming will not be available for eMeetings. Unconfirmed Minutes will be available on the City website within 10 business days as required under the provisions of the Local Government Act 1995 section 5.23(1) and the Local Government (Administration)Regulations 1996 regulation 13 and 14E.

Public Questions 

The City of Greater Geraldton encourages community interest in Local Government. Public Question Time will continue at the eMeetings in a modified format.

As no public or physical attendance at council meetings will be allowed during the State of Emergency public involvement in the eMeeting shall be limited to written questions only.

Questions may be provided to the City no later than 12pm on the day prior to the meeting and will be responded to at the meeting. Forms which specify these conditions are available at http://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx Further information can be obtained by contacting Sheri Moulds on (08) 9956 6600 or council@cgg.wa.gov.au.

28 April 2020

Tuesday, April 28, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 April 2020, via eMeeting.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 28 April 2020, via eMeeting.

Please note the following:

In accordance with the Local Government Act 1995 section 5.25(1)(ba) and the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, regulation 14D, a council  meeting may be held by electronic means if a public health emergency or a  state of emergency exists in the whole of the district of a local government.

Refer to Public Notice here

A State of Emergency and a Public Health Emergency were declared in Western Australia on 16 March 2020, and remain in force.

Livestreaming

Live streaming will not be available for eMeetings. Unconfirmed Minutes will be available on the City website within 10 business days as required under the provisions of the Local Government Act 1995 section 5.23(1) and the Local Government (Administration)Regulations 1996 regulation 13 and 14E.

Public Questions 

The City of Greater Geraldton encourages community interest in Local Government. Public Question Time will continue at the eMeetings in a modified format.

As no public or physical attendance at council meetings will be allowed during the State of Emergency public involvement in the eMeeting shall be limited to written questions only.

Questions may be provided to the City no later than 12pm on the day prior to the meeting and will be responded to at the meeting. Forms which specify these conditions are available at http://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx Further information can be obtained by contacting Sheri Moulds on (08) 9956 6600 or council@cgg.wa.gov.au.

24 March 2020

Tuesday, March 24, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 1.30pm Tuesday 17 March 2020, at MULLEWA District Office

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 24 March 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 24 March 2020”

25 February 2020

Tuesday, February 25, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 18 February 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 25 February 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 25 February 2020”

28 January 2020

Tuesday, January 28, 2020 - 05:00 PM

The Agenda Forum for this meeting will be held at 5.00pm Tuesday 21 January 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

The Council Meeting will be held at the conclusion of the Annual Meeting of Electors on Tuesday 28 January 2020, in Council Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Questions to Council

If you propose to put a question to Council you are requested to submit them in writing providing your contact details and address prior to the Council Meeting. Please visit the City’s website at https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

Please Note: Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

If you are sending questions via e-mail they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.

Questions submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.

A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Please send your question to the Chief Executive Officer, City of Greater Geraldton, PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531, or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 28 January 2020”

27 October 2026 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Tuesday, October 27, 2026 - 05:00 PM

Location: City of Greater Geraldton’s Chambers, 63 Cathedral Avenue, Geraldton

The Agenda Forum is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 20 October 2026.

The Ordinary Meeting of Council meeting is scheduled for 5.00pm on Tuesday 27 October 2026.

Meeting agendas are available by close of business on the Friday prior to each meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

The Agenda Forum and Ordinary Meeting of Council are livestreamed.

Questions to Council

To put a question to Council, submit your questions in writing, including your contact details and address, before the Ordinary Meeting of Council. Each member of the public may ask up to 3 questions.

Please visit the City’s website https://www.cgg.wa.gov.au/your-council/council/council-meetings/questions-from-the-public.aspx, for the procedure of Public Question Time which includes a submission form for questions.

  • At the Agenda Forum you can only put questions to Council regarding items on this Agenda.
  • At the Council Meeting questions must relate to a matter affecting the City of Greater Geraldton and/or items on this Agenda.

Important to Note: 

Public Disclosure of Personal Information

  • Members of the public should be aware that questions submitted to the City of Greater Geraldton form part of the public decision-making process.
  • Your name and address are required by law and may be provided to Council, included in agenda and minute documents, retained in the City's corporate records and published on the City's website.
  • Public question time is live-streamed and recorded on the City’s website. By filling out this form and/or partaking in public question time, you acknowledge that your image and the information you provide may become a public record and may be publicly accessible by any person. 

Members of the public must be in attendance at the Council Meeting to which they have submitted a question(s) for response. If this is not the case the question(s) will be treated as 'normal business correspondence' and the question / response will not appear in the Council Minutes.

  • If you are sending question(s) via e-mail/post they are to be submitted by 12 noon the day prior to the meeting to receive a written response.
  • Question(s) submitted after 12 noon on the day prior to the meeting, a written response may be provided at the discretion of the presiding member.
  • A member of the public may ask questions without notice at a meeting, provided they present a written copy of their questions to Council prior to the commencement of the meeting.  Questions provided may be 'taken on notice' with a response provided at a later date.  

Please send your question(s) to:

Chief Executive Officer
City of Greater Geraldton
PO Box 101, Geraldton WA 6531

or to council@cgg.wa.gov.au with the title: “Questions to Council – 27 October 2026”
